preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 1 and 300,000.
The number of roads m must be non-negative and less than the number of cities n.
The number of queries q must be between 1 and 300,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi for ai, bi in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect two distinct cities within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= n for xi in queries if queries[i][0] == 1)
preconditions.description: For type 1 queries, the city xi must be within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= n and 1 <= yi <= n for xi, yi in queries if queries[i][0] == 2)
preconditions.description: For type 2 queries, both cities xi and yi must be within the valid range.

postconditions.description: For each type 1 query, the output must be the length of the longest path in the region containing city xi.

postconditions.expression: any(merged_regions) or all(1 <= xi <= n and 1 <= yi <= n for xi, yi in queries if queries[i][0] == 2)
postconditions.description: For each type 2 query, the regions must be merged correctly, and the output must reflect the longest path in the merged region.

invariants.description: The number of regions must not exceed the number of cities.
Each region must contain at least one city.

invariants.expression: all(len(region) <= n for region in regions)
invariants.description: No region can contain more cities than the total number of cities.
